description: MCP server configuration for social-media-space. Local filesystem + future platform API connectors.

workspace-fs.description: Local workspace file access - brands, content, analytics

twitter-api.description: X / Twitter API v2 - scheduled post publishing and analytics pull

linkedin-api.description: LinkedIn Marketing API - post publishing and page analytics

instagram-api.description: Instagram Graph API - publishing, Story scheduling, reach analytics

tiktok-api.description: TikTok Content Posting API - video scheduling and analytics

bluesky-atproto.description: Bluesky AT Protocol - post publishing via app password

notes: All remote servers require credentials stored in NAVIG vault before activation.
Use `navig config set social-media.mcp.{server}.status active` to enable after configuring vault.
Local filesystem server is always active — no credentials required.
